title: Star Wars: Visions Presents - The Ninth Jedi Anime Streams Final Trailer
content: The official YouTube channels for the Star Wars franchise and Disney+ began streaming on Monday the final trailer for Star Wars: Visions Presents - The Ninth Jedi , the limited anime series spinoff from the Star Wars: Visions project. There are versions for the English dub and the Japanese dub with English subtitles.
author: ANN

title: Yang Can't Live Alone Manga Ends Publication
content: The author is in talks with the editorial department to get Square Enix to withdraw the copyright, so they can continue the manga another way. The third compiled book volume is still scheduled to ship on August 6. However, sooncha asked people to cancel their pre-orders of the new volume if they are uncomfortable.
author: ANN

title: Koei Tecmo's Attack on Titan 3 Game's Video Reveals December 10 Release
content: Koei Tecmo America announced in a new video for its Attack on Titan 3 game on Monday that the game will launch on December 10 for PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam .
author: ANN

title: Star Wars: Visions Presents – The Ninth Jedi Final Trailer Revealed Ahead of August 5 Release
content: Star Wars: Visions Presents – The Ninth Jedi revealed its final trailer, giving the last look at the upcoming anime series ahead of its August 5, 2026 premiere on Disney+ and Hulu. All 8 episodes will begin streaming at once.

title: Crunchyroll's Anime Nights to Screen Webtoon-Based Korean-Animated Film Your Letter on August 17
content: Crunchyroll confirmed on Monday that the WEBTOON -based Korean-animated film Your Letter will join its Crunchyroll Anime Nights theatrical screening program. The film will screen in Korean with English subtitles in the U.S. and Canada for one night on August 17. Tickets went on sale on Monday.
